provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Codenames rules (Czech Games Edition, via RulesPal)

steps.text: Split into two teams; each picks a spymaster, both spymasters sitting on the same side
steps.note: Standard game needs 4+ players; 2-3 player variants are on the back of the rules

steps.text: 25 random codenames in a 5 x 5 grid
Spymasters slide a random key card into the stand, hidden from the field operatives
Red and blue agent cards in front of their spymasters; bystanders and the assassin between them
The double agent goes to the starting team, flipped to its color
The lights on the key card's edge show the starting team: it has 9 words to find and gives the first clue
